sloka: अथोत्तमान्याभरणानि देवि ।देहि स्नुषायै व्यपनीय चीरम् ।न चीरमस्याः प्रविधीयतेति ।न्यवारयत् तद्वसनम् वसिष्ठः ॥२-३७-३४॥
transliteration: athottamānyābharaṇāni devi ।dehi snuṣāyai vyapanīya cīram ।na cīramasyāḥ pravidhīyateti ।nyavārayat tadvasanam vasiṣṭhaḥ ॥2-37-34॥

translations.english: O Kaikeyi remove those bark robes and bestow on your daughterinlaw precious ornaments. She was not ordained to wear the bark. Vaisishta, saying so, prevented Sita from wearing that garment.
